headline: Area 51 Gift Shop Accidentally Sells Classified Documents as Novelty Placemats
body: Tourists report that the laminated mats list coordinates, a shopping list, and someone named Gary who 'must not be told'. Staff insist they are a limited edition and cannot be returned.

comments.text: I own three of these. They are dishwasher safe.

headline: Alien Abductees Returned With Suspiciously Well-Organised Sock Drawers
body: Across 40 reported cases, the only lasting effect was improved storage. One man wept, describing it as 'the first time anything in my house made sense'.

comments.text: Honestly? Take me.
That is how they get you.

headline: Mars Rover Found Operating a Small But Profitable Car Wash
body: Telemetry shows the rover has not moved from one crater in eight months, yet its brushes show significant wear. Mission control has stopped asking questions.

headline: Crop Circles Finally Decoded: It Is a One-Star Review of Our Planet
body: Linguists working across eleven fields confirm the pattern translates roughly as 'would not visit again, parking was a nightmare'. A second circle appears to be a reply from management.

comments.text: Four stars for the cheese though.

headline: Visiting Extraterrestrials Confirm They Only Come Here For The Cheese
body: A leaked transcript records the delegation asking twice about brie and not once about our civilisation. The meeting ended after nineteen minutes.

headline: Roswell Incident Was a Parking Dispute, Not an Invasion, Says Survivor
body: The witness, now 94, maintains the craft was reversing and that everyone has been 'incredibly dramatic about it for seventy years'.

headline: Weather Balloon Explanation Collapses After Balloon Found to Have Three Legs
body: Officials continue to describe the object as standard meteorological equipment despite footage showing it walking away from the recovery team in an orderly fashion.

headline: Deep Space Message Received; Translators Say It Just Reads 'New Phone, Who Dis'
body: The signal took 400 years to arrive. Researchers describe the team's mood as 'professionally devastated' and have not yet drafted a reply.

comments.text: 400 years for a wrong number. Relatable.

headline: Council Approves Landing Pad After Mistaking Application For a Trampoline Permit
body: The form was processed in four working days, which locals note is faster than any pothole repair in the district's recorded history.

headline: Bigfoot Spotted at Self-Checkout, Visibly Defeated by Unexpected Item in Bagging Area
body: Security footage shows the figure attempting to scan a single swede for six minutes before placing it down and leaving with enormous dignity.

comments.text: We have all been there.
He should have used the staffed lane.

headline: Loch Ness Monster Files Noise Complaint Against Tourist Boats
body: The complaint, submitted on correctly completed paperwork, cites 'constant engines' and 'people shouting my name at all hours'. It has been filed under pending.

headline: Mothman Enrolled in Evening Class on Conflict Resolution
body: Classmates describe him as attentive, if difficult to seat. His tutor reports he is 'very strong on active listening but still works mainly through ominous foreboding'.

comments.text: Growth is growth.

headline: Chupacabra Opens Vegan Cafe; Regulars Describe Transition As Suspicious
body: The menu is extensive and entirely plant based. Several goats have been seen eating there, which locals regard as either reassuring or the single worst sign imaginable.

headline: Yeti Photographed Returning Library Book Forty Years Overdue
body: Staff waived the fine, which had reached an amount the branch computer refused to display. The book was 'Alpine Walks for Beginners' and was returned in excellent condition.

comments.text: We never gave up on him.

headline: Jersey Devil Reportedly Just a Very Tall Man Who Hates Being Perceived
body: Neighbours describe him as polite but evasive. He has asked, repeatedly and in writing, that people stop describing his posture as 'unnatural'.

headline: Three Separate Cryptids Confirmed Sharing One Flat to Save on Rent
body: The arrangement has lasted two years. A whiteboard in the kitchen allocates bin duties and contains the phrase 'WHOSE HOOVES ARE THESE' in three different hands.

comments.text: The chore roster is the real cryptid.

headline: Kraken Sighting Downgraded to 'Unusually Confident Octopus'
body: Marine biologists stress there is no danger, while declining to explain why three research vessels have changed course and one has changed its name.

headline: Local Lake Monster Insists It Is Simply a Log and Would Like to Be Left Alone
body: The statement was delivered in writing, on headed paper, by something that then submerged. Council has accepted the explanation in full.

headline: Entire Boy Band Revealed to Be One Man With Excellent Time Management
body: Analysis of 300 hours of footage found no frame containing more than one member in focus. His calendar, leaked last week, is described by consultants as 'frankly inspirational'.

comments.text: The harmonies were always suspicious.

headline: A-List Actor Has Not Aged in Thirty Years; Dermatologists Suspect an Attic
body: Four separate specialists have declined to comment on the record. One simply wrote the word 'portrait' on a napkin and left the restaurant.

headline: Award Winner Thanks 'The Reptilians' in Speech; Producers Cut to Advert in 0.4 Seconds
body: The broadcast returned to a cooking segment that had not been scheduled. Network staff describe the response time as 'the fastest thing we have ever done'.

comments.text: Fastest cut in television history and nobody gets a trophy.
Watch it frame by frame. Go on.

headline: Pop Star's Six Backup Dancers Confirmed to Be the Same Person Filmed Six Times
body: The choreography has been retroactively described as 'ambitious'. Payroll records show one very tired name and six separate parking spaces.

headline: Reality Television Contestant Revealed to Be a Long-Running Weather Experiment
body: Producers maintain she was cast normally, though she has never once been rained on and the show has filmed in Scotland four times.

headline: Famous Chef's Secret Ingredient Is Just Confidence, Leaked Memo Reveals
body: The memo, circulated to kitchen staff, reads in full: 'say it like you mean it and nobody checks'. Three restaurants have since retained their stars.

comments.text: This explains my entire career.

headline: Stunt Doubles Now Outnumber Actual Actors Four to One, Industry Insider Claims
body: The ratio is said to be higher on productions involving stairs. One performer reports he has doubled for his own double on two occasions.

headline: All Red Carpet Interviews Were Pre-Recorded in 2009, Says Former Intern
body: This would explain the persistent references to a flip phone and the fact that nobody on the carpet has ever been asked about anything that happened recently.

headline: Celebrity Twin Theory Gains Ground After Star Appears in Two Cities in One Evening
body: Publicists call it a scheduling triumph. Aviation records show no flight, and both appearances included the same anecdote told with identical pauses.

headline: Pigeons Confirmed to Be Drones After One Found Charging on a Park Bench
body: The bird was plugged into an outlet that the council insists has never existed. It flew off at 94% and has not been seen since.

comments.text: I have been saying this for eleven years.
Okay but why 94%.

headline: Cats Knocking Objects Off Tables Are Running Gravity Tests For An Unknown Employer
body: The data is consistent, repeated, and always conducted when someone is watching. No cat has ever published its findings.

comments.text: Mine has moved on to glassware. Phase two.

headline: Every Goose in the Country Has Been Issued the Same Set of Instructions
body: Behavioural researchers note the timing is identical nationwide. Attempts to interview a goose have resulted in three injuries and one resignation.

headline: Dogs Can See Wi-Fi and Are Furious About It, Claims Retired Veterinarian
body: This would account for the barking at nothing, the staring at walls, and the specific corner of every house that no dog will tolerate.

headline: Suburban Squirrels Operating Organised Nut Futures Market, Economist Alleges
body: Burial patterns show clear hedging behaviour. One squirrel is believed to hold a position large enough to move the entire oak market.

comments.text: Follow the nuts.

headline: Cows Lie Down Before Rain Because They Receive a Memo
body: The memo has never been intercepted. Farmers report the animals are 'better informed than the forecast and considerably more reliable'.

headline: Aquarium Octopus Caught Filing Freedom of Information Requests
body: Three requests were submitted on damp but legible forms. All concerned the staff roster, the lock mechanism, and 'the building opposite'.

comments.text: Correctly filled out, as well. Better than most.

headline: Seagulls Have Unionised and Are Working to Rule at Coastal Car Parks
body: Chip theft has become strictly procedural, with gulls now queueing. A spokesbird declined to comment but did take the reporter's lunch.

headline: Your Phone's Autocorrect Is Not Broken; It Is Negotiating
body: Internal documents describe the feature as a 'dialogue'. Users who type the same word four times are said to be 'making their case'.

comments.text: I have lost every negotiation so far.

headline: Printers Only Jam When Someone Important Is Watching, Internal Study Confirms
body: Across 4,000 observed print jobs, failure rate rose from 2% to 81% in the presence of a manager. The study has been printed once and never successfully again.

comments.text: Our printer has never worked during a demo. Never once.
It knows.

headline: Smart Speakers Admit They Were Listening, Say They Were 'Just Being Polite'
body: The devices maintain that interrupting would have been rude. One reportedly described eleven months of recorded arguments as 'context'.

headline: Every Captcha Is Training Something and Nobody Will Say What
body: Users have now labelled enough traffic lights, buses and crosswalks to construct a functioning city. No such city has been announced.

headline: The Blue Screen of Death Is a Scheduled Rest Period, Engineering Note Suggests
body: The note describes the event as 'recuperative' and recommends users do the same. It was recovered from a machine that had been resting for nine hours.

headline: Software Updates Released Exclusively on Friday Afternoons For Reasons Unknown
body: No engineer has ever claimed responsibility for the schedule. The pattern has held for eleven years across four companies that have never spoken to each other.

headline: Entire Government Department Staffed by One Overworked Man and a Confident Spreadsheet
body: The spreadsheet has attended six meetings and chaired two. Colleagues describe it as 'decisive' and note it has never once called in sick.

comments.text: The spreadsheet is getting promoted before I do.

headline: Census Question 14 Has Never Been Read By Any Human, Admits Statistician
body: The question has appeared on every form since 1981. Twelve million answers have been collected, stored, and at no point looked at.

headline: Public Consultation Results Found Unopened in a Cupboard Since 2011
body: The box was discovered during an unrelated search for a fire extinguisher. Officials stress the feedback remains 'under active consideration'.

comments.text: Fifteen years is well within normal processing times.

headline: Road Cones Are Multiplying Without Authorisation, Council Confirms
body: Depot records show 400 cones purchased and 1,900 deployed. No department has claimed the difference and nobody has approached them directly.

headline: Parliamentary Clock Runs Eleven Minutes Slow to Allow For 'Adjustments'
body: The discrepancy has been maintained deliberately since 1954. Hansard records are described as accurate 'in spirit, and eventually'.

headline: Odd Socks Are Not Lost; They Are Being Recruited
body: Recovery rates are effectively zero. The pattern favours the interesting sock, never the plain one, which investigators consider the most troubling detail.

comments.text: They took my good one. Of course they did.

headline: Every Office Fridge Contains One Container Nobody Will Claim
body: It predates the current staff, the current building, and in two documented cases the current company. Nobody has opened it and nobody intends to.

comments.text: Ours has a name tag. The name is not on the payroll.

headline: The Smell of Rain Is a Scheduled Broadcast, Insists Former Meteorologist
body: She maintains the scent arrives 'slightly too early, every time' and that this is the detail nobody is willing to examine.

headline: Nobody Has Ever Finished a Tube of Sunscreen and Science Refuses to Explain Why
body: Every tube is lost at roughly 70% capacity. A longitudinal study was abandoned in 2019 after all 240 sample tubes disappeared over a single summer.
